claims.title: Actual local coefficient setting, odd-place reversal, and signed normalization
claims.statement: W is a DVR with uniformizer p and residue cardinality p^n'; O is a DVR with fraction field K and w^2=p. The actual weight is lamAt: lambda0 at even s, negative reversal at odd s. A=Ar is the sum of the first r entries of these weights and may be negative.

claims.title: The exact polynomial coefficient model is full, finite free, and basis independent
claims.statement: The integral dual-Weyl polynomial module is the kernel of finitely many coefficient equations in a finite monomial module. It equals the integral-coefficient intersection with its fraction-field version. DVR algebra and clearing denominators prove fullness and freeness. The determinant-twisted inverse row action gives H_lambda(gO^k), independent of g and covariant under GL.
claims.derivation: This report replaces the source's explicit semistandard-basis proof of fullness by finite polynomial equations, clearing denominators, and finite-free module algebra over a DVR. It proves the source's actual DVR specialization; it does not claim the archive uses this proof.

claims.title: Elementary row-degree bound by a generic block column operation
claims.statement: For f in the column-invariant degree-nu module, every monomial has total degree at most sum_{i<=r}nu_i in the first r rows. Localize the generic matrix at the determinant of its top-left r-by-r block and kill the top-right block by earlier-column additions. The required upper-unipotent coefficients are independent of the row-scaling indeterminate, so the degree bound descends by injectivity of localization.
claims.derivation: Self-contained human proof in Section 4 of edge_lattices_report.txt and Lemma edge-weight of the main fragment. The cited source uses a semistandard basis plus bideterminant dominance instead. There is no source declaration claimed for the Gaussian-elimination proof.

claims.title: Signed highest-weight lattice scaling with all determinant exponents checked
claims.statement: For e=lambda_k, nu_i=lambda_i-e and A_r=sum_{i<=r}lambda_i=N_r+r e, multiplication by w^A_r sends H_lambda(gO^k) into H_lambda(g diag(w^-1 I_r,I)O^k). Target membership is exactly w^N_r T(D_w)f integral, proved termwise by EL3. No positivity of e or A_r is assumed.
claims.derivation: The conclusion is the source's lb_P/lb_pos scaling in the actual setting. The report proves it directly using EL3 rather than the source's weight-basis expansion. Integer powers are interpreted in K; only N_r minus a monomial degree is asserted nonnegative.

claims.title: Exact edge elementary divisors and the square-root midpoint lattice
claims.statement: Every edge pL+ subset L- subset L+ with quotient cardinality (p^n')^r admits L-=gW^k and L+=g diag(p^-1 I_r,I)W^k. Since w^2=p, the midpoint LeAt equals g_s diag(w^-1 I_r,I)O^k, where g_s=tau_s(g).

claims.title: Tensor edge inclusions and a perfect normalized integral pairing
claims.statement: With A=Ar, w^A H(source) subset H_e and w^A H_e subset H(target). Hence H(source) subset R_e and H(target)^vee subset R'_e. For R_e=w^-A H_e and R'_e=w^-A H_e^vee, beta(x,phi)=phi(p^A x) is a perfect integral pairing and p^A R_e=(R'_e)^vee.
claims.derivation: The source explicitly proves the two inclusions and normalized integrality. Perfectness and equality of the normalized polar are proved here from the full basis and w^-A p^A w^-A=1; they are not asserted to be a separate exported source theorem.

claims.title: Full three-slot coefficient lattice chain
claims.statement: For B_t=Nsrc, T_t=Ntgt, P_t=predual Ntgt, the exact chain is w^t H subset P_t subset H subset B_t subset w^-t H. All are full finite-free lattices of rank dim_K V in the appropriate primal or dual space. Ntgt itself is not the dual slot.

claims.title: Actual determinant-twisted covariance of every coefficient slot
claims.statement: The actual polynomial representation transports H, H_e, R_e and all three slots under the lattice GL action; on test functionals the action is contragredient. Tensoring over places and multiplying by the O-unit character gives the source JEquiv.

claims.title: The normalized neighbor sum sends ball sections to dual sections
claims.statement: The actual operator is (Y_v F)(L)=p^A_v sum_{L'->L_v}F(L[v:=L']). Incoming edges form a finite set. Normalized edge integrality gives the tensor-valued slot inclusion termwise. Reindexing edges proves equivariance, and the zero-off-lattice condition is preserved. This proves RestNat with no A_v>=0 assumption.

claims.title: Normalized error transport used in the joint-rank cancellation
claims.statement: For an edge e and c>=0, p^A(w^c R_e) subset w^c P_t(e.tgt). Thus a test vector vanishing to order w^c at an unwanted edge produces a normalized contribution in the corresponding w^c dual slot. When c>=2(D+1) this lies in p^(D+1)P_t; the source retains its stronger global cStar>=4(D+1) assumption.
claims.derivation: Apply the normalized polar inclusion of EL6 to an unscaled vector in R_e and then multiply by w^c. The report does not lower the archive's global LPprime exponent condition.
